synopsis: BeamNG.tech is described as a complete or near-complete commercial B2B simulation platform with real-time soft-body vehicle physics; public pricing was not found [f8350, f8502, f8503, f8508, f15909]. It provides programmable camera, lidar, radar, ultrasonic and IMU sensors, a Python API, and community-based ROS 2 integration, including a 2026 integration with Autoware [f8504, f8506, f9031]. Off-road driving is feasible, but its automotive-scale vehicle model is not a purpose-built excavator, dozer or haul truck with deformable soil [f8507, f15910]. Heavy-machine use is assessed as feasible rather than demonstrated, and independent heavy-machine correlation evidence was not found [f9029, f8509]. The latest release found was version 0.39, released on 20 August 2026 [f8505, f9033].

relations.note: Both describe off-road feasibility but automotive-scale rather than heavy-machine models.

Missing independent correlation evidence reinforces the lack of heavy-machine demonstration.
